name: leverrier-1846-table77
title: Le Verrier (1846), Table n° 77: 279 observations of Uranus, 1690–1845, transcribed and reconciled
description: Transcription of Table n° 77 of U. J. Le Verrier, 'Recherches sur les mouvements de la planète Herschel (dite Uranus)', Connaissance des Temps pour 1849, Additions, pp. 129–136 (Paris, 1846): the observed apparent right ascensions and declinations of Uranus that Le Verrier compared with theory before predicting Neptune, with his computed values and residuals. Transcribed twice, each pass without access to the other, and reconciled, with a first spot check against the scan; then spot-checked by a human against the Gallica scan (28 rows, 336 cells, 0 discrepancies). See README.md.

sources.title: Le Verrier 1846 offprint, Université de Lille scan
